::: {#rem-reducible-risk}
#### When the reducible risk is zero

The [reducible risk](#def-reducible-risk) is zero if and only if the [prediction function](#def-prediction) $\predfn$ equals the [conditional expectation function](#def-cond-expectation-function) with [probability](probability-basics.qmd#def-probability) 1.

$$
\E{\sqf{\E{\Outvar \mid \Predvar} - \predfnf{\Predvar}}} = 0
\iff
\P(\predfnf{\Predvar} = \E{\Outvar \mid \Predvar}) = 1
$$

:::
